set.body: Map comparison treats each map as a univariate sample over cells, so the Huo-Szekely (2016) O(n log n) algorithm for univariate distance covariance applies exactly. It would remove the need for DistanceCorrelationLimit (CR8 added a 2^28-pair default work bound: ~0.45 s at the limit, 3.6 s at 256^2). Must agree with the current double-centred implementation and the pinned eyesim fixtures to 1e-12.
set.title: Exact O(n log n) distance correlation for cell-wise map comparison
